Privacy

Updated 4 November 2026

When you buy. Stripe collects your name, email, billing address and payment details. We never see your card number. Stripe shares with us your name, email, country and what you bought. We keep them in our Stripe account to answer you and keep the tax records the law asks for.

This site. No cookies, no analytics, no tracking. The companies that host it (GitHub for this site, Cloudflare for the download page) keep standard server logs, such as IP addresses, for security.

Fader itself. It runs on your computer and sends us nothing. Fonts you pick from Google Fonts or Fontshare load from them, under their own privacy policies.

Emails. We only write to you about your purchase.

Your data. Ask us what we hold about you, and we'll show it, correct it or delete it, except what tax law says we must keep. Write to delarosbil.t@gmail.com.

Who we are. Nastya Tommy Inc., Ontario, Canada.
